reason: Although framed as a move/refactor, this PR touches a very central operator (`PhysicalProjection`) across optimizer rules, costing, explain/stringer, plan clone/cache paths, PB encode/decode, task building, and executor wiring. That breadth in core planner/executor code makes it plausible for Blocker/High regressions in plan semantics or runtime correctness to hide inside an apparently structural change.
